description: SKU-level master data describing how an item must be handled, independent of any StockUnit or bin. Owned by product-master (ADR 0034); this is this service's local copy. dotHazardClass adds a same-bin DOT segregation check enforced at stow time (ADR 0010).

dotHazardClass.description: Omitted/null unless handlingTags includes Hazmat AND a DOT hazard class was explicitly recorded (ADR 0010).
